In `module()`, the `Err(_)` branch re-calls `DirenvState::from_str(direnv_status)` after `serde_json::from_str::<RawDirenvState>(direnv_status)` has already failed, which causes an extra JSON parse attempt before falling back to the legacy line parser. Consider calling the legacy parser directly (e.g., `DirenvState::from_lines`) or restructuring the match so the input is only JSON-parsed once.
```suggestion
        Err(_) => match DirenvState::from_lines(direnv_status) {
```
